Narraive Copy: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. Bullet 2: Can hold up to 15 pounds
Bullet 3: Fits standard interior walls

Bullet 5: 2 1/2" of hanging space
